claims.C1.3-R1: paired full-batch within-epoch negative-time standard-deviation compression
claims.C1.7-R1: GPU full-batch negative-sampling mean and stability

configs.BL: RandomSorter(42)+ChunkPacker; original CPU Bernoulli(0.5) head/tail corruption; global train-triple collision set; H2D included
configs.GPU: RandomSorter(42)+ChunkPacker; tail-only GPUNegativeSampler; batch pos_tails filtering
configs.semantic_disclosure: BL and GPU samplers are intentionally non-equivalent runtime paths; this protocol makes no quality-equivalence claim

created_at: generated at run start; wall-clock timestamp is stored in environment.json

dataset.historical_alignment: Exact Phase 9 Step 2/3 split rule and sizes: 272115 -> 5000 held out + 267115 training
dataset.loader_order: incrementally populated set, then list(set(loader_set)), matching read_kge_dataset + KG

diagnostics.loss: finite required; final >= epoch0 is warning only
diagnostics.telemetry: before/after warmup, before/after each epoch, after job; never queried inside timed epoch

passes.compute_only: diagnostic only: fixed full batch and prebuilt GPU tensors, 3 warmups + 20 forward/backward/optimizer observations per seed

throughput.epoch_boundary: CUDA synchronize; timer starts before BatchProvider.iterate() executes and stops after final optimizer step and synchronize
throughput.loss_readback: GPU scalar accumulated; one CPU read per epoch

trace.neg_time_ns: sampler call start until negative tensors are ready on target GPU; BL includes Python sampling, CPU tensor construction and H2D
trace.positive_tensor_build_ns: positive h/r/t Python lists to GPU tensors; identical code in BL/GPU

preflight.vram_limit: peak reserved strictly below 90% of physical VRAM

statistics.A_gate_C1.2_C1.3: six valid pairs, complete raw data, valid protocol, lower 95% CI > 1
statistics.C1.2: mean five throughput epochs per config/seed; paired ratios; geometric mean and two-sided 95% t CI on log ratios
statistics.C1.3: ddof=0 within each trace epoch on full batches; mean five epoch standard deviations per run; paired ratios; log-scale t CI
statistics.C1.7: GPU full-batch neg-time mean per run; six-run arithmetic mean, sample SD and two-sided 95% t CI

training.warmup: three full training steps on a disposable model/optimizer; discard, clear cache, reseed, then construct measured model
